detail: The control group's only insulin and cortisol values are 24-h baseline means and areas from the authors' Pulsar pulsatile-profile fit, not means or trapezoid areas of the 20-min samples, and the model has no operator for them; its fasting IGF-I, IGFBP-2 and CBG have no marker in the model; and the medians (IQR) of the rest of Table IV are not a statistic the model covers.
